Name: Contaminated Binaries
Description: Every so often, your visual readouts of ones and zeroes are broken by an unholy aberration: a two. If you fail a Tech Test by rolling a double — a Fumble — you suffer the Stunned Condition for 1d5 rounds.

Name: Circular Reasoning
Description: The infinite digits of pi twist infest your streams of prayer and incantation. When you take an Extended Tech Test, the duration of the Test is extended by a further period after the point at which it should be completed (at least one round).

Name: Voices of the Dead
Description: Ancient recordings occasionally overwhelm your auditory sensors, spewing blasphemies or trivialities into your mind and occasionally out of your vox unit. Whenever you fail a Tech Test you gain the Deafened Condition until the end of your next turn.

Name: Data-Rot
Description: Some ancient data has infested your augmetic’s systems, filling your mind with baffling half-truths and lies mixed with brilliant insights. The GM makes all Lore Tests for your character in secret. Whatever the result, your character is convinced that any facts that come to mind are the absolute and unquestionable truth.

Name: Tantalising Data
Description: A string of partially deciphered code weighs heavily on your mind, an opportunity that you struggle to ignore. During downtime, the base Difficulty of any Test you make is Difficult (−10) or you may choose to undertake one fewer Endeavour that you otherwise could to negate this effect.

Name: Dominant Programming
Description: A degraded machine spirit randomly overcomes your will, forcing you into its repetitive programming. When you take damage to the head, you must pass a Difficult (−10) Discipline (Composure) Test or spend your next turn repeating whatever action you attempted during your last turn.

Name: Lockdown Sequence
Description: An archeotech mechanism to secure a device from damage has seeped into your systems. Whenever you take a Critical Wound, make a Challenging (+0) Discipline (Composure) Test. On a failure, you are Restrained until the end of your next turn.

Name: Augmetic Ghost
Description: The fractured binharic remains of a long-dead Tech-Priest have infested your augmetics. Their form occasionally appears beside you when you gaze into the noosphere, capable of faint communication.

Name: Data Addiction
Description: Your augmented mind craves a constant flow of new information. You must pass a Difficult (−10) Discipline (Composure) Test to resist seizing every opportunity to acquire new knowledge, regardless of the associated risk or delay. If you fail, you must spend one of your next Endeavours researching that topic (the GM may award you an Advance for your efforts).

Name: Killing Charge
Description: You crackle with electricity, glutted with the Motive Force. Any character that touches you immediately suffers 1 Wound.

Name: Random Shutoff
Description: Corrupted ancient code interferes with the function of your augmetics. Once per session, a random augmetic will shut off at an inopportune time, taking one minute to reactivate.

Name: Xenotech Traces
Description: Some archeotech you interfaced with bore alien Corruption, and the taint of it lingers on you still. The ordinary machine spirits found in imperial technologies are rightfully fearful of you, and the Difficulty of Tests to interact with such devices is always at least Challenging (+0).

Name: Words of the Dead
Description: You have been instilled with data from a dead language. When speaking, you may randomly switch to this incomprehensible tongue, suffering Disadvantage on all Rapport Tests.

Name: Rad-Saturation
Description: Your body is saturated with uncontained radiation. You and characters in the same Zone are Poisoned (Minor) while in your presence.

Name: The Flesh is Weak
Description: An unaugmented part of your body begins to rot or atrophy. Over time, you lose the ability to see through unaugmented eyes, speak without the aid of a vox implant, or eventually even move without an appropriate augmetic to replace your withered flesh.

Name: Blind to Corruption
Description: The lines between what is permitted and what is not become increasingly blurred to you. The GM tracks your Corruption in secret and makes all associated Tests in secret on your behalf.

Name: Haywire Oration
Description: Some malignant spirit or irresistible urge infests your mind, your cogitator, or your vox implant. Once per session, the GM may speak on your behalf, saying in that moment whatever words will inconvenience you most.

Name: Augmetic Rejection
Description: Even the strength of steel begins to fail you, as your body degrades and devours augmetics at an incredible rate. You must frequently replace and repair your augmetics, which fail at a rate of at least one per mission, often at an inopportune moment.

Name: Expendable Flesh
Description: Viral coding drives your augmetics to protect themselves by sacrificing your flesh. When you suffer a critical wound, roll twice, suffering the higher result.

Name: Mind of Iron
Description: You have suffered the ultimate hubris of the ancients. An abominable intelligence, or something masquerading as one, has transferred its heretical consciousness to your augmetics, offering its wisdom, but at a terrible cost. You may follow its advice to turn any failed Tech or Lore Test into a success with +1 SL. However, each time you do, you gain 1 Corruption.
